mentions.name: Space Station Overhead Checker
mentions.description: A website that checks when a manned space station, such as the ISS, was last directly overhead of your house, computing the closest passes of the ISS to a specific location over the last 30 years. Inspired by xkcd 2883.
mentions.problem: Looking up the ISS's location at a specific time is easy, but finding its closest passes to a specific location over the last 30 years on demand is more complicated.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on site that let's you check when a manned space station was last directly over your house.
